description: Author an agent skill from text: name, description, instruction body, an optional slash command, and an optional invocation (`auto`, the default: the assistant may use it on its own; `manual`: only when the user invokes it). Team scope requires admin or owner, private scope is your own. Pass `boundWorkspaceId` to bind the skill to one matter (any member who reaches the matter may, for team scope too) or `boundClientId` to bind it to one client (admins and owners only); a bound skill is visible and usable only there, and the binding cannot change later. A command must be lowercase letters, digits, hyphens, or underscores, must not be one of the reserved commands, and must be free in the organization, as must the skill name. Refused once the per-user or per-organization skill limit is reached. Use skills.upload or skills.from-url.import for a packaged skill instead.
